title: Headlines
about: The top stories of a news feed, newest first, with the source and how long ago.
prompt: Make a Facet screen "Headlines" listing the five newest stories from my news feed sensors (sensor.news_story_1 to 5, the title is the state, the source in the attribute source). Keep each headline on one line.
better: Source logos would come with the icon component.

title: Game progress
about: Wins, a streak and the latest runs of a roguelike, from a Steam or save-file sensor.
prompt: Make a Facet screen "Game progress" for my roguelike: the hero is my win count (sensor.isaac_wins) of all runs (sensor.isaac_runs), then my win streak, achievements and the last three runs with how they ended.
better: Character portraits and achievement badges would come with the icon component.

title: AI agents
about: What each AI agent is doing: working, needs you, done or idle, with a mascot that shows it.
prompt: Make a Facet screen "AI agents" with one tile per agent (sensor.agent_docs, sensor.agent_firmware, sensor.agent_review, sensor.agent_research): the state is working, needs, done or idle and the attribute status says how far it has got.
better: A grid layout would let a screen mix agent tiles with a summary.

title: Shopping list
about: A tick-off shopping list from a Home Assistant to-do list.
prompt: Make a Facet screen "Shopping list" from todo.shopping: a count of what is left, then each item as a checkbox, ticked ones done.

title: Medication
about: Today's doses, which are taken and when the next one is due.
prompt: Make a Facet screen "Medication" for today: the next dose time as the hero (sensor.next_dose), then each dose of the day as a checkbox, the ones taken ticked.

title: Bin day
about: Which bins go out next and how many days are left, from a council collection sensor.
prompt: Make a Facet screen "Bin day": how many days until the next collection (sensor.bin_days) as the hero with which bins go out, then each bin with its next date.
better: Bin colour icons would come with the icon component.

title: Next trains
about: The next departures from your station with platforms and delays.
prompt: Make a Facet screen "Next trains" for my commute (sensor.next_train_1 to 3 from the National Rail integration): the first train as the hero with its platform, then the next departures with on time or the delay.
better: A grid would put platform and delay in columns.

title: Parcels
about: Deliveries due today and this week, with where each one is.
prompt: Make a Facet screen "Parcels" from my parcel tracking sensors: the number arriving today as the hero, then each parcel with its status and when it is due.
better: Courier logos would come with the icon component.

title: Energy price
about: The electricity price now, the cheap and peak hours of the day and when to run the dishwasher.
prompt: Make a Facet screen "Energy price" from my Octopus Agile sensors: the price now as the hero in pence per kWh, the day as cheap / normal / peak hours with now marked, and the cheapest slot.

title: Plant care
about: Which plants need water today, by their soil moisture.
prompt: Make a Facet screen "Plant care": how many plants need water as the hero, then each plant with its soil moisture and when it needs water.
better: The plant gauge, once released, would draw each moisture as a bar.

title: Chores
about: Each child's jobs for today, ticked off as they go.
prompt: Make a Facet screen "Chores" for my two kids: how many jobs are left today as the hero, then each job as a checkbox starting with whose job it is, done ones ticked.
better: Avatars per child would come with the icon component.

title: Focus
about: A focus session timer: time left, which session it is and a break after.
prompt: Make a Facet screen "Focus" for a pomodoro timer (timer.focus): the time left as the hero, a ring that fills as the session runs, then the session count and what comes next.

title: Homelab
about: Servers and services at a glance: what is up, CPU load and anything that needs a look.
prompt: Make a Facet screen "Homelab": how many services are up as the hero with anything that needs a look, each server with its load, then the NAS CPU over the last hour as a small line.

title: 3D printer
about: A 3D print under way: how far along, time left and the temperatures.
prompt: Make a Facet screen "3D printer" for my Bambu printer: the print progress as the hero with the file name, then time left, layer, nozzle and bed temperature.

title: Run weather
about: Is it good for a run or a ride: the weather now and sunset.
prompt: Make a Facet screen "Run weather" from weather.home: the temperature with a one-line verdict for a run, then wind, rain chance, UV and the next dry window.
better: A weather icon beside the temperature would fit once a row layout is released.

title: Guest Wi-Fi
about: A QR code guests scan to join the Wi-Fi, with the network name and password.
prompt: Make a Facet screen "Guest Wi-Fi" with a QR code for my guest network (WIFI:T:WPA;S:Guest;P:<password>;;) that phones can scan, and the name and password written under it.

title: Laundry
about: The washer and dryer: minutes left, the programme and when it ends.
prompt: Make a Facet screen "Laundry": the washing machine time left as the hero with its programme and end time, then each machine and the detergent left.

title: Air quality
about: Indoor air: fine particles, CO2 and humidity, with the trend today.
prompt: Make a Facet screen "Air quality" from my indoor air sensor: PM2.5 as the hero with a one-line verdict, then CO2, VOC and humidity, and the PM2.5 trend today as a small line.

title: Birthdays
about: Days to the next birthday and who comes after, from a calendar.
prompt: Make a Facet screen "Birthdays" from calendar.birthdays: days to the next birthday as the hero with who and how old, then the next three.

title: Fixtures
about: Your team's next match, the latest result and the league position.
prompt: Make a Facet screen "Fixtures" for my football team from the TeamTracker sensor: the next kick-off as the hero, the last result and league position, then the next three fixtures.
better: Club crests would come with the icon component; a grid would line up scores.
